description: This file defines an abstract class 'TypeResolver' within the 'Orleans.Serialization.TypeSystem' namespace. The class provides method signatures for resolving a type from a string name, including methods 'ResolveType' and 'TryResolveType'.

classes.name: TypeResolver
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods for resolving a Type from a string name.

methods.name: ResolveType
methods.description: Abstract method to resolve a Type from a string name, throwing an exception if resolution fails.

methods.name: TryResolveType
methods.description: Abstract method to attempt to resolve a Type from a string name, returning true if successful and false otherwise.
